items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: Now the good drum like Contra, they all explain it, tune your snare drum...

ctx.x: I don't like it, it looks like a little tom-tom.

Little tom-toms, yeah. Really? But I really like the bass drum I'm working on now. I think that's a 1426 bass. And I believe that's, my idea is best for jazz, better volume. And then you take this kind of damp weather right now, that instrument will still, you just give it a certain tune-up, it'll hold its volume, you know. And the way I pad, man, mute it. Now I just have a side muffler to it, and I take some old pieces of these, what you call this, these pads you put on your back, you know, for pains like that,…

a piece of rag over it, well that makes the drum too tudd like, you understand? It's like your snare. Now the good drum like Contra, they all explain it, tune your snare drum, maybe a twist more on the batter side and let the snare side a little looser. It gives it a better volume too.
